documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: An earlier inquiry from our construction services team requested discovery about disconnected teams. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's operational friction involves 'disconnected teams' and conflicting project status updates, as noted in the customer inquiry. The construction services team previously requested a discovery meeting, but the latest call indicates the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. This contradiction needs clarification before any further action.

claims.quote: An earlier inquiry from our construction services team requested discovery about disconnected teams.
The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your team has previously requested discovery about disconnected teams, but there appears to be a contradiction in the project status—some indicate the project is paused, and the owner disagrees about the requirement. To ensure we align with your needs, could you clarify the current project status and the specific requirements related to disconnected teams?
questions: Could you clarify the current project status and whether the requirement for workflow coordination is still valid?
What specific challenges are you facing with disconnected teams that you'd like to address?
uncertainties: Conflicting information about the project status and requirement validity.
Unclear specifics about the disconnected teams' challenges.
